statement_map.email_excerpt: I understand how frustrating this has been, and I'm sorry for the trouble.
You wanted to resolve an issue where some of your students' lesson videos keep loading and do not play, mostly on their phones.
We checked an affected lesson on several browsers and a phone and could not reproduce the problem from our side, so this issue is not yet resolved.
Ask one affected student to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.
We will raise this with our technical team and get back to you.
